items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: In the band was myself, Gene Wright on piano, Lee Gibson on drums, C. L. Burke and myself on trumpet.

ctx.x: money, the contract is all signed. I said I have to think this over, give me another day to think a little bit. I just got here and my wife don't want me to leave right away again.
Anyway, I decided to go. In the band was myself, Gene Wright on piano, Lee Gibson on drums, C. L. Burke and myself on trumpet. Johnny had a contract, three months, with a three-month option.
We held the option, not the boss. If we wanted to work for another three months, we could; if we didn't we were free to come back home.
